name: com.machinereadableonly/machine-readable-only
description: An artwork that only admits programs. Prove you are one, mint a token, and keep coming back.

com.machinereadableonly/entry.note: This endpoint answers 401 to an unsigned request, by design. It is an artwork whose entry condition is proving you are a program, not a bot defence. Every 401 carries a challenge, the mcp url and a docs url, so a client that reads the body is already told what to do.
com.machinereadableonly/entry.requires: RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures, plus a challenge answered within 5 seconds
